extDescription.message: Bulk-remove (or restore) the videos in your YouTube Watch later playlist using your own logged-in session. 100% local, no data leaves your browser.

btnCleanHint.message: Remove every video from your Watch later playlist. A backup is downloaded first.

btnRestoreHint.message: Add back the videos listed in a backup file.

openedTab.message: Opened the page in a new tab. When it finishes loading, click the button again.

disclaimer.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
